findings: Honors user's no-over-scaffolding rule: the P16 plan assumes 9 new records crates; instead this slice adds 1 module to 1 existing crate. Scaffold count delta: 0. The remaining work is tracked under F-M02B-PLAN-LIVE-CRATE-RECONCILIATION.
FhirResourceType is strictly additive — zero changes to existing RecordingArchiveEntry or RecordingsSurfaceStaging code paths.
FhirResourceType is a zero-cost pure discriminant enum (Copy + Clone + Ord). No allocations at variant selection. Suitable for high-throughput PHI record routing without per-call overhead.
ontology_type() returns a format!() String — acceptable at call boundary; callers are expected to cache the type string in hot paths. No heap allocation in data_class() or all().
FhirResourceType is exhaustive — new FHIR resource types require explicit enum extension, preventing silent fall-through.
No deserialization surface introduced in this slice; FhirResourceType does not implement Deserialize, so no untrusted-input attack vector.
#![forbid(unsafe_code)] prevents memory-safety exploits.
All() iterator helper prevents callers from hand-coding the 9-variant list, eliminating variant-omission bugs.
ontology_type() and data_class() have consistent self-by-value signatures (Copy type), so callers never need to manage lifetimes.
Enum is pub in pub mod fhir_resource_type with a re-export at crate root — single import path for consumers.

6/6 new fhir_resource_type tests pass: ontology_type_returns_records_prefix, all_nine_types_return_phi_data_class, all_returns_nine_variants, variants_are_ord_sorted_alphabetically, clone_and_copy_are_consistent, ontology_type_covers_all_nine_variants.
Coverage includes: round-trip ontology_type prefix check, PHI data_class assertion for all 9 variants, Ord sorting invariant for declaration order, uniqueness of all 9 ontology_type strings.

Variants are declared in alphabetical order matching Ord derivation (AllergyIntolerance < Condition < DiagnosticReport < Encounter < Immunization < Medication < MedicationRequest < Observation < Procedure).
Alternative A — scaffold full 9-crate records-fhir BC as planned: rejected by user-directive-option-2 (2026-05-17); over-scaffolding risk, blocked by P02-ontology IP-001.
Alternative B — use a string type instead of enum: rejected; enum provides exhaustive matching, zero-cost copy, and compile-time variant safety.
Alternative C — place FhirResourceType in a new micro-crate: rejected; no consumer other than oya-connect-recordings-domain exists today; adding a crate just for a 9-variant enum is over-engineering.
All 9 FhirResourceType variants return 'Phi' from data_class() per ADR-0008 §'clinical records'. PHI classification is structurally enforced — cannot return a non-PHI class for any current variant.
FhirResourceType carries no stored data — it is a pure discriminant; no PHI payload is held in the enum itself.
